sourceBoundaries: The active Grants.gov form establishes a cross-agency structural and wire contract. NIH Forms-I instructions are an agency policy layer and do not silently replace or narrow that contract.
The live NIH G.430 HTML is mutable. The byte-pinned Forms-I Fellowship PDF is the stable instruction artifact for this source foundation.

The sample PDF is an XFA form with JavaScript. Its packets are retained as deterministic behavior evidence; no XFA behavior is treated as portable or executable until reviewed and represented declaratively.
Attachment controls are capture mechanisms. Each attachment purpose remains a candidate semantic question and is not collapsed into one generic attachment question.

semanticBoundary.statement: Deterministic source extraction is pinned, but no source occurrence has been accepted as a canonical reusable question and no proposed runtime rule has been accepted for execution.
prohibitedInferences: an XSD leaf is necessarily an applicant question
a DAT business rule is executable without path and operator review
two attachment fields are equivalent because they use the same capture mechanism
NIH instructions are universal cross-agency policy

notVerified: accessibility, privacy, security, policy, operations, registration, and release

parityClaim: This source foundation proves exact source identity, byte provenance, dependency closure, and extraction lineage only. It does not claim semantic, behavioral, renderer, XML, accessibility, policy, or production parity.
